meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把内容做成可浏览的 HyperFrames 互动幻灯片：分页、逐条碎片出现、热点跳转分支，并带演讲者备注；也会把现有网页转换成幻灯片。产出是可操作的演示页，不是渲染出的视频文件。
howto.when: 用户明确要求“幻灯片”或“slide show”时直接开始；提到“演示文稿”“deck”或“把此页面转成幻灯片”等时，先确认是否要 HyperFrames slideshow，确认后才制作。

say.text: 做一套8页幻灯片，讲我们新产品的市场机会。
say.note: 会生成可浏览的 deck，不是视频。

say.text: 把这份产品介绍页改造成幻灯片，保留动效。
say.note: 会先确认是否要 HyperFrames slideshow。

say.text: 在第二页加一个热区，点击跳转到附录。
say.note: 会建立分支，观众点击后进入附录序列。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a navigable HyperFrames deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter notes. It can also turn an existing page into a deck. Output is interactive, not a video.
howto.when_en: Starts directly when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow or slide show. For adjacent wording like 'presentation,' 'deck,' or 'convert this page,' it confirms the HyperFrames slideshow choice before building.

say_en.text: Make an 8-slide deck about our new product's market opportunity.
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck, not a video.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a slideshow, keeping the motion.
say_en.note: Asks for confirmation before building a HyperFrames slideshow.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 2 that jumps to an appendix.
say_en.note: Creates a branch viewers can click into.
